pricing.notes: Cache write $1.25 (30-minute retention) or $2.50 (12-hour). Max input 922K tokens. Over 272K input tokens the whole request is billed at 2x input and cache / 1.5x output. Batch & Flex 50% off; Fast mode 2x; regional processing +10%.

effort.notes: Hosted tools (computer use, code interpreter, MCP, hosted shell, apply patch) are Responses API only.

best_for: Visual reasoning: matching product photos to catalog entries, reading technical drawings
Computer use on application screens at half GPT-6.1 Sol's price
Clear, natural writing and revision at mid price
watch_out: Fit ratings are provisional: launched 2026-10-26 with no official benchmarks yet. Rated 4.5 only where OpenAI's model page positions it (visual reasoning, computer use, writing); coding and analysis held at the previous Terra's 3.5 until a benchmark run
PDF input is not listed on the model page
Use the Responses API for hosted tools such as computer use
prompt_tips: Same guidance as the GPT-6 family: goals and constraints over recipes; set effort explicitly
For screen and image tasks, name the target element or field you need back
